    ToolsRTM

    An R packages with tools for simulating canopy reflectance using a set of radiative transfer (RT) models at Sentinel-2 scale

    Getting started

    Install the package prospect with the following command line in R session: > > devtools::install_gitlab(‘caminoccg/toolsrtm’) >

    Manual

    Manual is available at ReadTheDocs https://toolsrtm-tutorial.readthedocs.io/en/latest/

    Description

    This package integrates the main radiative transfer (RT) models for simulating canopy reflectance with remote sensing tools for estimating plant traits at Sentinel-2 scales.
